plan.title: Split lots disabled on closed RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX event creation screen.
Create an RFQ-only event so the lot-splitting control is applicable.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Commit a short schedule so the event can be published.
Add the required QA vendor participant.
Publish the RFQ before closing it.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Close the published RFQ so its closed-state Settings menu can be checked.
Assert that the lot-splitting menu item is present but disabled on the closed RFQ.
